[1;38;5;244mwhile Claude is working[m                                                                             
[38;5;215m  Enter[m  [38;5;244mqueues the message; the whole queue goes out as ONE turn when the[m                          
[38;5;215m  [m  [38;5;244mturn ends — one turn, because each one re-bills the whole context[m                               
[38;5;215m  Esc[m  [38;5;244minterrupts the turn, so the queue goes out as the redirect[m                                   
[38;5;215m  /queue[m  [38;5;244msee what is waiting · /queue clear drops it[m                                               
[38;5;215m  note[m  [38;5;244mthe queue is never saved — a crash loses it rather than delivering[m                          
[38;5;215m  [m  [38;5;244mit into whatever phase the run comes back in[m                                                    
                                                                                                    
[1;38;5;244mkeys[m                                                                                                
[38;5;215m  Enter[m  [38;5;244msend the message[m                                                                           
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+J[m  [38;5;244mnewline without sending — works in every terminal[m                                         
[38;5;215m  Alt+Enter[m  [38;5;244mnewline without sending — works in every terminal[m                                      
[38;5;215m  Shift+Enter[m  [38;5;244mnewline, but ONLY where the terminal speaks the Kitty keyboard[m                       
[38;5;215m  [m  [38;5;244mprotocol (Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, iTerm2 3.5+). Anywhere else it[m                               
[38;5;215m  [m  [38;5;244mis indistinguishable from Enter and simply sends — use Ctrl+J[m                                   
[38;5;215m  paste[m  [38;5;244ma multi-line paste arrives whole; it never sends[m                                           
[38;5;215m  drag a file[m  [38;5;244mdropping or pasting a file path attaches it as an absolute path —[m                    
[38;5;215m  [m  [38;5;244mClaude reads it with its own Read tool, so nothing is sent until it does[m                        
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+G[m  [38;5;244marm the plan (start auto-run)[m                                                             
[38;5;215m  Esc[m  [38;5;244minterject / interrupt the current turn[m                                                       
[38;5;215m  ↑/↓ PgUp/PgDn[m  [38;5;244mscroll the transcript[m                                                              
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+C[m  [38;5;244mquit[m                                                                                      
                                                                                                    
[1;38;5;244mwhile a gate is counting down[m                                                                       
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+Y[m  [38;5;244mallow the front tool now[m                                                                  
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+X[m  [38;5;244mstop (veto) the front tool[m                                                                
[38;5;215m  Ctrl+R[m  [38;5;244mpause / resume every countdown[m                                                            
[38;5;215m  any other key[m  [38;5;244mtypes into the message box as usual[m                                                
[38;5;215m  Esc[m  [38;5;244mdoes NOT interject — answer the gate first[m
